dataset.title: MapIT India-Focused Global Technology Employers on LinkedIn
dataset.intended_use: Employer discovery and LinkedIn job navigation for itmap.in / MapIT.
dataset.scope: Curated Indian and international technology employers with more than 200 LinkedIn-associated employees or an equivalent LinkedIn company-size band, and an established or recurring India hiring presence.

minimum_threshold.measurement: Public LinkedIn-associated employee count or LinkedIn company-size band
minimum_threshold.warning: LinkedIn figures are dynamic and should not be treated as audited payroll headcount.

dataset.coverage_note: This is a large curated directory, not an exhaustive export of every eligible company on LinkedIn. LinkedIn does not publish a complete public company directory, and company pages, names, employee counts and open jobs change over time.

link_behaviour.jobs_section_link: The company-specific Jobs tab on LinkedIn; it may show no vacancies when none are live.
link_behaviour.india_jobs_search_link: LinkedIn jobs search prefilled with the employer name and India location.

dataset.recommended_refresh_cycle: Every 30–60 days for page slugs; daily or at click time for live openings.
